notes: Moto Guzzi V7/V9 Euro 5 applications. The Moto Guzzi service manual and MIUG4 technical material prove CAN diagnostics and commercial tools prove identification, DTC, TPS/adaptation and memory functions exist. No public Moto Guzzi capture or definition file was found for the diagnostic CAN identifiers, ISO-TP addressing or UDS/KWP payloads. The old 0x7E0/0x7E8 plus K-Line-style 1A 80 definition was generic inference, not evidence. Physical CAN sessions are therefore blocked before sending a request.

can.note: No bitrate, CAN identifiers, addressing mode, or padding is claimed without a family-specific capture.

session.note: ISO-TP physical transport alone does not establish UDS/KWP services or identifiers.
session.physical_blocked_reason: ISO-TP transport, CAN identifiers, addressing, and diagnostic application payloads remain unvalidated.

identification.reason: No validated family-specific diagnostic application definition is available.

memory.write_blocked_reason: Unverified transport; no write path exists.

sources: Moto Guzzi V7/V9 Euro 5 service-station manual 2Q000466: MIU G4 application and diagnostic-tool procedures
ASW-NEXT MIUG4 technical user manual: CAN connection and supported operations (no wire identifiers/payloads)
Diagcode Piaggio Group coverage: MIU G4 Euro 5 CAN operation existence only
